scope: HPG current-analysis data readiness only; no scoring or DI approval

findings.currentAdmissionPolicy: admitManualStatement enforces historicalAvailability VERIFIED and publishedAt only in HISTORICAL_REPLAY branch. CURRENT_ANALYSIS still requires qualified retained/hash-verified issuer sources and no future period/import/review/publication.
findings.currentSufficiencyPolicy: evaluateHybridTarget never reads historical PIT readiness; current LOW is produced by unresolved debt materiality/qualified cash bridge and freshness. Separate reporting of historical NOT_READY is warranted; weakening historical guard is not.
findings.coverageIsNotDecisionGrade: Existing fundamentalScorable predicate can accept PARTIAL/MEDIUM. It is financial-input eligibility only, not six-section decision-grade completeness or official scoring readiness. CORE35/35 alone cannot resolve qualified cash, normalized/downside EBITDA, supporting semantic definitions, current market, qualitative or governance requirements.
findings.latestCurrentVsPastPeriods: Old annual inputs support baseline comparability and normalized analysis. Their age must not be confused with current statement freshness; missing historical publication availability does not contaminate current admissibility.

BusinessQuality: normalized ROIC / NOPAT / economic invested-capital definitions or explicitly justified applicable substitute
ordinary-common-share earnings for sustainable ROE where used
cash conversion and maintenance capex; cost curve/competitive durability not merely spot commodity profit
FinancialHealth: approved reported borrowing carrying basis with case-specific uncertainty assessment
qualified unrestricted cash for Net Debt
normalized/downside EBITDA and compatible lease policy for leverage
interest coverage, liquidity, maturities and survivability; spot EBITDA insufficient for MATERIALS
Growth: comparable revenue/EPS/NPAT baseline with corporate actions
capacity expansion economics under normalized prices and incremental returns; historical revenue alone insufficient
Industry: retained source-supported structure, competition, cost position and company-relative position
normalized forward asymmetry and cycle evidence; commodity momentum alone insufficient
ValuationInputs: normalized common earnings or EBIT/EBITDA/FCF denominator appropriate to HPG
base/conservative scenario assumptions, cross-check and method selection; financial statements alone insufficient
Risk: case-specific opaque-financing quantitative and qualitative materiality
cash restriction, lease and debt maturity limitations
governance/related-party/auditor/control concerns and residual risk without double counting

independentChallengeRequirements: An immaterial conclusion retains UNKNOWN and amount; does not certify comprehensive debt
Any cash qualification must bind precise amount and restriction/source review; disclosure silence is insufficient alone
No report-only EBITDA, arbitrary line subtraction, or six-month annualization may satisfy normalized/downside EBITDA
Missing common-share/economic operating-profit definitions cannot be blanket waived using coverage
HistoricalReplayReady false must coexist with admissible current-qualified statements without opening historical guard
